key.name: api-base-url
key.description: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible transcription service. The extension appends /v1/audio/transcriptions.

key.name: api-key
key.description: Optional bearer token. Leave empty for a local service without authentication.

key.name: language
key.description: ISO-639-1 code passed to the service, e.g. de or en, or "auto" to let the service detect the spoken language. Leaving this empty is not the same as auto: the field is then omitted and the service falls back to its own configured default.

key.name: max-recording-seconds
key.description: Recording stops automatically after this many seconds.

key.name: set-primary-selection
key.summary: Also write to the PRIMARY selection
key.description: When enabled, the transcript also replaces the middle-click paste buffer. Required for pasting into terminals via Shift+Insert.

key.name: restore-clipboard
key.description: Save whatever is in the clipboard before the transcript overwrites it, and put it back once the transcript has been pasted. Only the CLIPBOARD selection is restored, not PRIMARY. Multi-format content (e.g. rich text offered as both HTML and plain text) comes back in one format only.

key.name: clipboard-restore-delay
key.description: How long to wait after the paste keystroke before restoring. There is no signal for “the application has read the clipboard”, so this is a guess: too short and the target pastes the old content instead of the transcript. The previous content is only put back if the clipboard still holds the transcript, so copying something else in the meantime is safe.

key.name: history-size
key.description: How many transcripts the panel menu offers for copying back to the clipboard — the way out when a paste went nowhere because no text field had focus. Kept in memory only: never written to disk, and dropped when the extension is disabled, which includes locking the screen. 0 turns the list off.

key.name: translate-to-english
key.description: Ask the service to translate instead of transcribe.

key.name: remove-fillers
key.description: Strip hesitations and stutter repetitions from the transcript.

key.name: mark-pauses
key.description: Insert an ellipsis for longer pauses, a paragraph break for very long ones.

key.name: model
key.description: Model identifier passed to the transcription service.

key.name: temperature
key.description: Sampling temperature passed to the transcription service (0 = deterministic, 1 = creative).

key.name: empty-speech-action
key.description: placeholder: paste the placeholder text below. skip: do not change clipboard or paste anything.

key.name: empty-speech-placeholder
key.description: Used when empty-speech-action is placeholder. If empty, behaves like skip.

key.name: panel-indicator-box
key.description: Which top-bar region holds the status icon: left (activities side), center (date area), or right (system status).

key.name: panel-indicator-position
key.description: Index used when inserting the status icon into the chosen top-bar section. Use − / + in preferences to reorder among other icons in that section.

key.name: show-icon
key.description: Whether to show the microphone icon in the top panel. When disabled, you can still trigger recording via keyboard shortcut or by running the extension from the Extensions app.

key.name: play-sound
key.description: Play a short sound effect when recording starts and stops.

key.name: request-timeout
key.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for a transcription response.

key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to start or stop speech recording. Format: accelerator string, e.g. '<Super>z'.

key.name: enable-shortcuts
key.description: Whether the toggle-recording keyboard shortcut is active.

key.name: sound-volume
key.description: Volume for start/stop sound effects. 0 is muted, 100 is full volume.
